description: This file defines a Next.js page component for rendering individual blog posts based on URL parameters. It includes static parameter generation, page metadata, and the React component rendering the post content.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Returns static parameters for pre-rendering pages, specifically with a fixed slug 'welcome-to-xperthrivr'.

methods.name: BlogPostPage
methods.description: React component that renders a blog post page using parameters from URL, displaying the slug with hyphens replaced by spaces.
